formal: My flatmate has been late in paying their share of the bills for three consecutive months. The plan is to leave a note on the refrigerator and to change the wifi password until they have paid. I have no standard by which to judge late bill payments, and therefore I will proceed with this plan without making a decision of my own. I have consulted you on household financial matters of this kind beforehand for many years. What is your view?
